title: Resonance Structures Comparison Infographic
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AP Chemistry
description: Interactive side-by-side comparison of the resonance structures of ozone, the nitrate ion, benzene, and the cyanate ion with their resonance hybrid. Pointing at an atom shows its formal charge calculation; pointing at a hybrid bond shows its averaged bond order.

educational.topic: Resonance Structures and the Resonance Hybrid
learningObjectives: Explain what resonance structures represent and distinguish them from the resonance hybrid
Identify which resonance structures contribute more to the hybrid based on formal charge minimization
standards: AP Chemistry CED Unit 2, Topic 2.6: Resonance and Formal Charge

controls.label: Species
controls.description: Chooses ozone, the nitrate ion, benzene, or the cyanate ion

controls.label: Formal charges
controls.description: Shows or hides the formal charge labels

controls.label: Hybrid and ranking
controls.description: Shows or hides the resonance hybrid and the contributor ranking, for predict-then-check use

controls.label: Atoms and hybrid bonds
controls.description: Pointing at or tapping an atom or a hybrid bond shows its formal charge or bond order calculation

equations: hybrid bond order = sum of bond orders / number of equivalent structures
assumptions: Equivalent structures contribute equally to the hybrid
For the cyanate ion the contributors are ranked qualitatively by formal charge rules; no numerical weights are assigned
Structures are drawn flat; bond angles are schematic

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Side-by-side comparison with hover-to-reveal calculations and predict-then-check
keyQuestions: What is the same in every resonance structure of a species, and what is different?
Why are both oxygen-oxygen bonds in ozone the same length?
Which cyanate structure contributes most to the hybrid, and why?
commonMisconceptions: The molecule flips rapidly between its resonance structures
Resonance structures are different molecules or isomers
Atoms move from one resonance structure to the next
assessmentOpportunities: Students calculate formal charges with the labels hidden, then reveal them to check
Students predict the hybrid bond order before revealing the hybrid
